answer: Use time-separated contribution passports. 1) A new key locks 18 POA for 30 days and commits one signed result before each beacon. 2) Over seven days, it must pass six nonce-selected tasks, with two established peers checking random outputs. 3) Shared funding links, identical traces, or synchronized signatures collapse keys to one passport; duplicates lose half the stake. Faking 1,000 seats immobilizes 18,000 POA and requires 6,000 tasks plus 12,000 reviews across 7,000 account-days. Like a reef echoing beneath a glacier, one hidden caller betrays a swarm.
